subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Which remaining prevention boundary should own this Anthropic signed-thinking replay cluster: the scoped SDK/managed-transport fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 or the broader session-history sanitizer approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149?
rationale: Both approaches address the remaining create-side replay exposure but differ in compatibility risk for provider-owned signed-thinking replay, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary alone.

options.title: Prefer scoped converter fix
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 the canonical prevention path for completed-turn native Anthropic replay and close sibling broader attempts after it lands.

options.title: Prefer sanitizer-wide guard
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149 or an equivalent sanitizer-level fix if maintainers want one central guard across more replay surfaces.

options.title: Defer prevention
options.body: Declare merged recovery sufficient for now and keep prevention as explicit follow-up debt rather than treating this issue as fixed.

recommendation.title: Prefer scoped converter fix
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 the canonical prevention path for completed-turn native Anthropic replay and close sibling broader attempts after it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He already commented on the split between recovery and remaining create-side work and merged the first recovery slice.
